sampling.order: sha256 of input task identity, seed repobench-cohort-v1
sampling.fork_lineage: full owner/repository plus explicitly supplied alias map; unknown lineage is not certified independent

splits: stable sha256 family assignment; 60% development, 20% validation, 20% holdout
fitting: declared scoring candidates and coordinate search on development only
nomination: eligible validation dependency coverage; development tie-break; retain baseline on ties
subgroups: report every declared repository group; no post-hoc exclusions or subgroup retuning
uncertainty: equal-weight repository mean coverage delta; 2000 bootstrap samples; seed 20260926; descriptive 95% interval
holdout: freeze exact cases, labels, splits, baseline, nominee, implementations, and promotion rule before evaluating any held-out outcome
scope: supplied-corpus completion transfer; no claim about all native intents or downstream coding success
